season.end: Last calendar day of February in delivery year
season.seasonDayDefinition: Actual calendar days elapsed since April 1 of the preceding year; leap-day observations are retained.
season.historicalBandRule: Aggregate within each delivery year first; equal-weight comparable completed years. Exclude current/partial seasons.
season.coverageRule: Comparable means completed year, at least 150 observations across all 11 season months, an observation by April 15 and on/after February 15; inspect gaps separately.
season.februaryCaveat: February observations are not necessarily before first-notice or holding dates.

conversion.usdSpread: MATIF EUR/t * EURUSD - US cents/bu /100 * bushels/t
conversion.positiveSpread: MATIF premium over the US March contract

matif.updatesNote: Initial history comes from the supplied workbook; subsequent published settlements and revisions come from Euronext.
matif.openInterestNote: Euronext open-interest timing may differ from the workbook; source revisions are retained.

us.requiredSource: Actual same-delivery-year March Chicago SRW / KC HRW futures
us.officialDefinition: Close is the official settlement price; last-trade exceptions have a 9-suffixed root, unlike ZW and KE.
us.volumeOpenInterestNote: Latest vendor volume/open-interest fields may lag; reported zero values are retained and do not establish inactivity.
us.dailyUpdate: Norgate individual March settlement; 14 calendar day revision overlap

notes: Descriptive daily settlement comparison; venue settlements and ECB reference times are not synchronized.
No futures prices are carried across dates. Only FX may use a prior observation, limited to three calendar days.
March 2002 is a partial first season. Early MATIF contracts have many zero-volume days; zero reported OI may mean unavailable history.
Current March 2027 is incomplete and must be excluded from historical seasonal bands.
This dataset is not a trading backtest or evidence of executable spread profits.

collection.coverageNote: Recent published dates are collected; older missing business dates require a historical source.

refresh.method: Public GitHub Actions collector; no private Site access
